Careers at Flex

Apply today

Come create the extraordinary

We are the manufacturing partner of choice that helps a diverse customer base design and build products that improve the world. Through the collective strength of a global workforce across approximately 30 countries and responsible, sustainable operations, we deliver technology innovation, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions to various industries and end markets.

Our people are the industry’s best makers, problem-solvers, innovators, craftspeople, and leaders pushing the limits — and working together globally — to design and build a wide array of our customers’ products that touch people’s lives for the better. When you join Flex, you’ll be working among some of the brightest people on groundbreaking projects with the world’s leading brands.

Join our values-driven, high-performing culture

Build your career alongside agile innovators, skilled makers, and leaders of today and tomorrow, who live our values by supporting each other as they find a better way, moving fast with discipline and purpose, and doing the right thing, always. We prioritize employee safety, well-being, and inclusiveness to provide a work environment where every team member can thrive.

Explore how we can create the extraordinary, together

Grow your career

We foster a learn-and-adapt mentality and cultivate a work environment of continuous improvement. We invest in today and tomorrow’s industry experts and leaders to acquire new skills, knowledge, and experiences. You can grow your career and prepare for challenging and versatile roles through our formal, on-the-job, and upskilling learning programs and opportunities.

How to apply: Members of our talent acquisition team share insights about the recruitment process and how to make your resume stand out.

Learn how to apply for a career at Flex

A collaborative environment powered by respect and open communication

Our people create the extraordinary and bring world renowned brands’ products to life, every day.

Representing a global mosaic of cultures, experiences, expertise, perspectives, and abilities, our ~150,000 employee team moves forward together through a values-driven, high-performing culture.

We nurture a safe work environment where every team member can thrive. Encouraging a learn-and-adapt mentality, we offer development programs and learning opportunities to help employees prepare for versatile roles in an ever-changing world.

Our people

A career at Flex is limitless, enriching and dynamic. Our people are empowered, collaborative, and responsible makers, problem solvers, innovators, craftspeople and leaders, helping propel industries and end markets forward at every stage of the product lifecycle.

We entrust our employees with great responsibilities and recognize teams and individuals for outstanding performance. We communicate openly and cultivate strong relationships to drive results. Through many ways, including employee volunteerism and our Flex Foundation, we promote a sense of community and help each other succeed, all while doing the right thing, always.

Providing competitive benefits to elevate employee well-being

Our employees are the lifeforce of our company, and we strive to reflect this value in our culture and compensation. Our total rewards packages are informed by market data, company results, employee performance, grade-level, and location. We aim to provide our employees with support for all dimensions of their lives, including financial security, health, and work-life balance.

Offerings vary per country and location, but span:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Paid time off
  • Ongoing growth opportunities such as an internal mobility
  • Mental health and wellness resources
  • Volunteer and community engagement programs

Empowering growth through our comprehensive development programs

We foster a growth mindset centered on continuous improvement and invest in industry experts and leaders to acquire new skills, knowledge, and experiences.

We promote development that inspires personal and professional growth and advancement through multiple career acceleration programs. Through our initiatives, we’re investing in the leaders of today and tomorrow, with programs designed to develop team members at Flex sites globally.  

We also provide various learning opportunities including formal training, on-the-job experience, and upskilling programs. These include our Mechanicals University, Master’s Degree Program in collaboration with multiple universities across Mexico, and our global CAP Quality certification program. These resources support our employees’ growth at any stage of their career.  

Building the future of the manufacturing industry through internships and apprenticeships

With a global footprint of ~100 sites in ~30 countries, our teams at Flex work together to deliver technology, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions and services to a diverse range of customers across many industries.

We offer a variety of early career opportunities such as internships, apprenticeships, and co-op opportunities at many of our sites around the world to help you build a thriving career.

Accelerate your growth with Flex
Blog
Start a career in manufacturing at Flex
Blog
An open letter to students on Manufacturing Day

What does an intern do at Flex?

When you intern at Flex, you’ll have the opportunity to harness cutting-edge tools and technologies within the manufacturing industry, contribute to meaningful projects, and collaborate with diverse teams to create products that truly make a difference. Our interns are actively innovating, learning from the best, and making an impact.

At Flex, we prioritize employee safety, wellbeing, and development. Our early career programs include opportunities in manufacturing and design, from technical to non-technical roles. Our internship, apprenticeship, and co-op opportunities are designed to help you develop a wide variety of skillsets and gain hands-on experience with advanced manufacturing processes and concepts.

Start your career in manufacturing with Flex

Our local programs dedicated to early career talent provide meaningful, hands-on opportunities for students and graduates to work in a business and manufacturing environment and learn new skills. Choose from a wide range of career paths before committing to a full-time job with internship and apprenticeship opportunities available in engineering, business analysis, automotive engineering, product design, IT, mechanical engineering, polymechanics, and more.

Internships and co-op programs

Jump start your early career with one of our paid part-time or full-time internship opportunities for students in Flex locations throughout the Canada, U.S., Mexico, EMEA, and APAC.

Search internships and co-ops

Apprenticeships

We offer structured multi-year paid apprenticeship experiences throughout regions of EMEA, with 80% of your learning happening within the Flex site.

Search available apprenticeships in Austria

Hear from some of our interns and apprentices

Flex is a global leader providing creative and valuable solutions. Being a firmware engineer, I thought an internship would be a great opportunity to work with the automotive team at Flex and contribute to innovative solutions.

— Kapil Mulchandani, Stuttgart Design Center, Germany

I embraced the challenge and the open, collaborative culture made it easy for me to adapt to this experience.

— Evelin Chavez, Mexico

Having an internship experience at such a reputable organization can significantly enhance one’s resume and open doors for future career opportunities.

— Rishalni Chandrasekaran, Malaysia

I am learning engineering skills from the most fundamental to advanced techniques. In addition, I am getting trained with soft skills and leadership abilities since the curriculum focuses on more than the technical aspects.

— Palaniraj M, Chennai, India

An extraordinary learning lesson I got from my time at Flex is that it’s often the tiny details that matter and that it’s important to have a good team to work with.

— Adam Wernig, Austria

I learned so much about the manufacturing industry, and there is so much more to learn, but I think the most valuable lesson was how to be a more confident communicator.

— Brooke Anderson, U.S.

Global job opportunities

Our ~150,000 employees across ~100 sites in approximately 30 countries work together to deliver technology, supply chain, manufacturing solutions and services to a diverse set of customers and create the extraordinary, every day.

We believe in nurturing a values-driven, high-performing culture and providing a safe, inclusive work environment to empower our team members to thrive. Learn more about why people choose to grow their career at Flex around the world.
